global_sequence_description: Surveillance footage of a computer hardware aisle where a synthetic subject conceals a small electronic component inside the front pouch of their hoodie.

chronological_sequence_segments.scene_description: The subject stands in the aisle carrying a white plastic shopping bag in their left hand, holding a small square component box in their right hand, and looking around.
The subject swiftly lowers their right arm, pushing the square box directly down into the front kangaroo pouch of their gray hoodie.
The subject removes their empty right hand from the pouch, bringing it up to rest near their chest, and turns their body slightly to exit the area.
